blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Vice President Sara Duterte’s camp on Wednesday accused National Bureau of Investigation (NBI) Director Melvin Matibag of being “evidently politically biased” against her. This is on top of Duterte’s counsel, Atty. Paul Lewrence Lim, describing Matibag as a “person heavily burdened with conflict of interest” as he probed the accusations of former police officer Rodulfo Gracioso Jr., who was also former House Speaker Lord Allan Velasco’s former aide.
